guardians.name: Baoli Warden
guardians.title: Keeper of the stepwell
guardians.blurb: A sandstone giant with lattice eyes. It sweeps its steps and drops its ledges on the count.
guardians.intro: Listen for the count. Move on the hit.
guardians.calmLine: The Warden sinks into turquoise water, at peace.

guardians.name: Patang Twins
guardians.title: Kites on one string
guardians.blurb: Magenta and ochre paper kites that dive and tug their glowing string from side to side.
guardians.intro: Two kites, one string. Watch which side tightens.
guardians.calmLine: The twins fold into paper birds and drift away together.

guardians.name: Brass Mayur
guardians.title: The clockwork peacock
guardians.blurb: A cast-brass peacock automaton. Its fan flashes gold before every strike.
guardians.intro: Watch the fan. Three dings, then the strike.
guardians.calmLine: The Mayur folds its fan and bows.

guardians.name: Lattoo Titan
guardians.title: The spinning top
guardians.blurb: A towering lacquered spinning top. It wobbles, whirrs and topples, but never falls.
guardians.intro: Listen for the whirr. It always tells you which way.
guardians.calmLine: The Titan slows into a music-box spin.

guardians.name: Megh Drummer
guardians.title: The monsoon cloud
guardians.blurb: A rain cloud with three drumheads on its chest. It plays a call, then plays it again.
guardians.intro: The cloud drums twice. Same again, same answer.
guardians.calmLine: The cloud breaks into a rainbow.

guardians.name: Night Mail Colossus
guardians.title: The locomotive that stood up
guardians.blurb: A steam engine made of trunks and whistles. Four phases, ending at the Terminus.
guardians.intro: Three rising whistles means it is coming. Ready?
guardians.calmLine: The Colossus becomes a toy train circling your shelf.
